extracted.name: Cook all day Great Northern Beans with smoked Turkey parts
extracted.description: Cold Snowy February day, a little something to warm my bones
instruction_lines: Add dry beans to water and bring to a boil
Remove from heat and let stand one hour to tenderize beans
Return to medium flame and add smoked turkey necks, or other parts if desired, and garlic.
Bring to boil, add celery green pepper diced and onion reduce heat and simmer one and1/2- 2 hours until beans are tender. (If using fresh carrots 🥕 add here)
Add canned carrots, salt, pepper and cook another 15 min
Remove from heat and serve hot with cornbread or desired
